originalAlarm.description: The value written to `&driver_data` is never used.

model:
(define-fun CONFIG_UNIX98_PTYS () Bool
  true)
(define-fun CONFIG_DEVPTS_MULTIPLE_INSTANCES () Bool
  false)
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: The alarm reports 'driver_data = &some_int' (line 39, inside ptmx_open()) as a dead store when DEVPTS_MULTIPLE_INSTANCES=false and UNIX98_PTYS=true. When the normal (non-error) path is taken (nondet() returns false, no goto), driver_data is assigned at line 39 and then the function returns 0 without using driver_data further. In the real Linux ptmx_open() code, driver_data is used for the ptmx file descriptor setup after being initialized. Simplification artifact. Note: the known bug for 7acf6cd80b2.c is that driver_data is UNINITIALIZED on the error path (goto err_release taken before line 39). The alarm here fires on the normal path assignment, which is the opposite scenario.
